title: Badminton Worlds: Indian Hopes on Sindhu, Satwik-Chirag
indian_angle: Indian fans will be keenly watching PV Sindhu and the men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty as top medal contenders.
summary: As the Badminton World Championships begin, India's medal aspirations are primarily focused on the seasoned PV Sindhu and the dynamic men's doubles duo, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.

title: Sindhu, Lakshya Sen Lead India's Singles at Worlds
indian_angle: This article details the key Indian singles players, PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen, who will be spearheading the nation's challenge at the prestigious BWF World Championships.
summary: India's singles campaign at the BWF World Championships will be spearheaded by former world champion PV Sindhu and young talent Lakshya Sen, both aiming for strong performances.

title: Treesa Jolly, Gayatri Gopichand's Comeback Road to Worlds
indian_angle: Indian fans will be interested in the journey of this promising women's doubles pair as they overcome injury to compete on the world stage.
summary: India's top women's doubles pair, Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand, are making their return to the World Championships after Treesa's significant ankle injury sidelined them for several months.

title: Indira Gandhi Stadium: A Legacy of Indian Badminton Greats
indian_angle: This piece highlights the historical significance of an Indian venue where legendary Indian badminton players achieved memorable feats.
summary: The Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium in New Delhi holds a rich legacy in Indian badminton, having hosted iconic moments including Syed Modi's 1982 Asian Games bronze and India's 1988 Thomas Cup qualification.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior Worlds Trials
indian_angle: This news directly impacts the composition of India's junior women's doubles team for the upcoming World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a change in the women's doubles pair selected for the trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp in Guwahati
indian_angle: This highlights the ongoing preparations and training for India's promising young badminton talents for international junior competitions.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian U17 & U15 junior teams is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing them for the Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.
